cmd: cd /opt/weather-tg && for f in weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_2weeks.py; do curl -sf -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/$f -o $f.new && mv $f.new $f; done; python3 -m py_compile weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_2weeks.py && echo COMPILED_2W; grep -c "TELEGRAPH_TOKEN=" tg.env; [ "$(grep -c "TELEGRAPH_TOKEN=" tg.env)" = "0" ] && timeout 40 python3 weather_tg_2weeks.py --setup 2>&1 | tail -3; grep -c "TELEGRAPH_TOKEN=" tg.env; timeout 150 python3 weather_tg_2weeks.py --force --page-only 2>&1 | tail -12; echo TW_DONE
